vetSays.line: 🛡️ Jorge, Caleb, Ruby, Liam and Jesse met them at the door — 5 put down. Jorge, Caleb, Ruby, Liam, Jesse are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Ruby just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Austin just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Ruby and Jesse met them at the door — 2 put down. Jesse is hurt.

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
★ IDENTIFIED: Ground Elder. Creeping patches of divided leaves in shady spots. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Desmond taught everyone about Ground Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Ground Elder — named and noted.
🛡️ Zoltan met them at the door — 1 put down. Zoltan is hurt.
Desmond drew Ground Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Miguel just put down The Algorithm... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elijah just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Zoltan just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Caleb met them at the door — 1 put down. Caleb is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aurora just put down The Big Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🌿 Ground Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 Ground Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Adoma just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rolf just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Adoma, Pearl and Rolf met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 barely walked away. Pearl, Rolf are hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rolf just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Mateus just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Rolf and Mateus met them at the door — 2 put down.

opens.openerLine: "Hey." Jorge settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to."
"Interesting — Do you still sing? ...Sorry — weird question. I just realized I haven't heard anyone sing."
"What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing."
"Can we talk?" Austin doesn't wait for an answer. "We need to discuss how things are run here."
"I've been turning something over. What do YOU think actually happened to us? Anyway, that's me."
"About what you think happened to us — I've been turning something over. What do YOU think actually happened to us?"
"Okay, real question: what's the funniest thing you've seen since we got here? I desperately need it."
"About what you're hoping for — What are you hoping for? Not the big stuff. The small thing."
"Hah. What did you do for fun? Before. The thing you'd do on a perfect Saturday."
"Do you dream about before? Or is it all — this — now?"
"I keep expecting to see them by the fire. Then I remember."
"I'll tell you plain — It's quiet today. Wrong kind of quiet."
"About the funniest thing you've seen — Okay, real question: what's the funniest thing you've seen since we got here? I desperately need it."
"Can we talk?" Jesse glances around first. "People are saying things. About you. Is any of it true?"
"What's something you're good at that nobody here knows about? Easy."
"What do you miss most? From before."
"Look — My hands know things my brain hasn't caught up to yet. Muscle memory from chimney sweep days."
"Well — Is there someone here you don't trust? Be honest."
"Okay, so — something happened this morning."
"You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Shyngys? Hm."
"About that news I was bursting to share — You'll never guess what I saw by the treeline. Mark my words."
"About who you don't trust — Is there someone here you don't trust? Be honest."
"About what happened to my taken kin — I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one."
"I can't reach this properly. Will you help me clean it?"
"About what happened to my taken kin — Have you heard anything? About the taken. The pods. Anything at all."
"You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Amanda?"
"About that news I was bursting to share — Have you heard? No? Good, I get to tell you first."
"Can I tell you something? At night I cry quietly so no one hears."
"You'll never guess what I saw by the treeline."
"Can I trust you? I mean really."
"About this wound — still need hands. Are you in?"
"About what happened to my taken kin — You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Shyngys?"
"Do you still count the days? I lost track days ago."
"Can we talk?" Liam sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
Someone has to make decisions here. I'm just saying — it might as well be someone who knows how.
Caleb: "I've heard good things about Stonebridge. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
Austin: "I've heard good things about Thornfield. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"What scares you most about what's happening? The real answer. I mean it."
"What do you make of all this? Really."
"Can we talk?" Theo sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"It's quiet today. Wrong kind of quiet."
"I don't know what to do with my hands today. I need you to hear that."
"About what scares you most — What scares you most about what's happening? The real answer."
"Hah. Don't mind me. Today's just heavy."
"Hey. Got a minute? No reason. Just — hey."
"We're down to 1 liters of clean water. Haul the creek with me at dawn? Two buckets each, there and back."
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it?"
"I asked Lily about what scares you most — Lily's gone. What scares you most about what's happening? The real answer. You'd know about that."
"Can I tell you something? I've been sneaking out at night. I'm ashamed and I can't stop."
"I keep expecting to see them by the fire. Then I remember. ...never mind."
"Every laugh out there feels wrong today. Then I feel wrong for thinking it."
"Water's almost gone — 7 liters. Haul the creek with me at dawn? Two buckets each, there and back."
"I asked Austin about what scares you most — Austin's gone. What scares you most about what's happening? The real answer. Simple as that."
Jesse: "You. Yeah, you. What do you make of this?"
"The cistern's nearly dry — 1 liters left. I need someone to haul water with me at first light. Two of us, half the trips. Will you come?"
"Why do you ask? Do you believe in anything? Now, I mean. After everything."
"I asked Chester about the creek water run — Chester's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"I asked Theo about the creek water run — Theo's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"Can we talk?" Miguel sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"I'm going hungry — do you have anything to eat? Anything at all? My hands shake when I try to work."
"We're down to 4 liters of clean water. I can't carry enough alone. First light, the creek, you and me?"
"About the creek water run — still need hands. Are you in?"
"About the creek water run — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"About the food I needed — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"About the creek water run — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"Never mind the creek water run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"I keep expecting to see them by the fire. Then I remember."
"Got a read on anyone here yet? Who should I be watching? You know?"
"Can we talk?" Zoltan sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"What's something from your old life that's actually useful here, anyway?"
"About your read on people here — Got a read on anyone here yet? Who should I be watching? Good talking."
"They'd tell me to keep working. So I'm working. That's the whole plan. Doesn't matter now."
"I asked Annelie about your read on people here — Annelie's gone. Got a read on anyone here yet? Who should I be watching?"
"Listen to me — It's quiet today. Wrong kind of quiet."
"Have you — sorry. I keep thinking about them. Sorry, what was the question."
"I can't reach this properly. Could you take a look?"
"About this wound — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"I'm going hungry — do you have anything to eat? Anything at all? I can't keep going like this."
"I asked Zoltan about your read on people here — Zoltan's gone. Got a read on anyone here yet? Who should I be watching?"
"About the food I needed — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"About the food I needed — still need hands. Are you in?"
"About the food I needed — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"About this wound — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
Aurora: "I've heard good things about The Red Table. We should link with them — we'd be stronger together."
"What's the kindest thing someone's done for you out here?"
"Can I tell you something? Before the scattering, I stole from someone who trusted me. I think about it every day."
"I asked Sanne about the kindest thing someone's done for you — Sanne's gone. What's the kindest thing someone's done for you out here?"
"About the kindest thing someone's done for you — What's the kindest thing someone's done for you out here? That's my read."
"Are you angry? At whoever did this. At the sky. At anything."
"About whether you're angry — Are you angry? At whoever did this. At the sky. At anything."
"About the kindest thing someone's done for you — What's the kindest thing someone's done for you out here?"
"That lean-to won't fix itself. Grab an end?"
I'll help when it counts. But I won't live in anyone's pocket.
"Are you going to stay? With us. For real."
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the north treeline by the fallen oak."
"About whether you're staying — Are you going to stay? With us. For real!"
"About the pantry run — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Forage with me tomorrow? I know the meadow edge, west of the creek."
"About the pantry run — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"About the pantry run — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"About whether you're staying — Are you going to stay? With us. For real."
"About the pantry run — still need hands. Are you in?"
"About whether you're staying — Are you going to stay? With us. For real. Just... be straight with me."
I need space the way other people need food. Don't take it personally.
You eat first. No — don't argue. I already ate. (I hadn't.)
Groups make noise. Noise gets you noticed. I work better quiet.
"I don't know what to do with my hands today."
"They'd tell me to keep working. So I'm working. That's the whole plan. Anyway."
"When's the last time you really laughed? Funny how that works."
I'm fine on my own. I was fine before all this. Don't take it personally.
It's not that I don't like people. It's that I like breathing more.
You need something? Ask. Otherwise I've got my corner and my thoughts.
"I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one."
"About what happened to my taken kin — Have you heard anything? About the taken. The pods. Anything at all."
"About the last time you laughed — When's the last time you really laughed?"
"About what happened to my taken kin — You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about James?"
"Do you ever just need to be alone? Like, really alone? Seen worse."
"About needing to be alone — Do you ever just need to be alone? Like, really alone?"
You look like someone who survives. Stick with me and we both keep surviving.
"You look handy. What did you do with your hands, before?"
"I asked Aurora about what happened to my taken kin — Aurora's gone. I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one. Worth considering."
"About what happened to my taken kin — Have you heard anything? About the taken. The pods. Anything at all. Sorry, what was the question."
"This wound — I can't clean it properly one-handed. Will you help me clean it?"
"What's the most useful thing you've learned since we got here?"
"I asked Aurora about needing to be alone — Aurora's gone. Do you ever just need to be alone? Like, really alone? Give it time."
"About needing to be alone — Do you ever just need to be alone? Like, really alone? It'll pass."
"Never mind this wound — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"I asked Ostap about the most useful thing you've learned — Ostap's gone. What's the most useful thing you've learned since we got here?"
"Can we talk?" Rolf sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"I can't reach this properly. Could you clean it out for me? Please."
"About this wound — still need hands. Are you in?"
"About this wound — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"About this wound — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
I don't need thanks. I need everyone breathing tomorrow.
"You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Fernanda?"
